properties.name: spring.mvc.apiversion.default
properties.description: Default version that should be used for each request.

properties.name: spring.mvc.apiversion.detect-supported
properties.description: Whether supported versions should be detected from controllers.

properties.name: spring.mvc.apiversion.required
properties.description: Whether the API version is required with each request.

properties.name: spring.mvc.apiversion.supported
properties.description: Supported versions.

properties.name: spring.mvc.apiversion.use.header
properties.description: Use the HTTP header with the given name to obtain the version.

properties.name: spring.mvc.apiversion.use.media-type-parameter
properties.description: Use the media type parameter with the given name to obtain the version.

properties.name: spring.mvc.apiversion.use.path-segment
properties.description: Use the path segment at the given index to obtain the version.

properties.name: spring.mvc.apiversion.use.query-parameter
properties.description: Use the query parameter with the given name to obtain the version.

properties.name: spring.mvc.async.request-timeout
properties.description: Amount of time before asynchronous request handling times out. If this value is not set, the default timeout of the underlying implementation is used.

properties.name: spring.mvc.contentnegotiation.default-content-types
properties.description: List of default content types to be used when no specific content type is requested.

properties.name: spring.mvc.contentnegotiation.favor-parameter
properties.description: Whether a request parameter ("format" by default) should be used to determine the requested media type.

properties.name: spring.mvc.contentnegotiation.media-types
properties.description: Map file extensions to media types for content negotiation. For instance, yml to text/yaml.

properties.name: spring.mvc.contentnegotiation.parameter-name
properties.description: Query parameter name to use when "favor-parameter" is enabled.

properties.name: spring.mvc.dispatch-options-request
properties.description: Whether to dispatch OPTIONS requests to the FrameworkServlet doService method.

properties.name: spring.mvc.dispatch-trace-request
properties.description: Whether to dispatch TRACE requests to the FrameworkServlet doService method.

properties.name: spring.mvc.format.date
properties.description: Date format to use, for example 'dd/MM/yyyy'. Used for formatting of java.util.Date and java.time.LocalDate.

properties.name: spring.mvc.format.date-time
properties.description: Date-time format to use, for example 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'. Used for formatting of java.time's LocalDateTime, OffsetDateTime, and ZonedDateTime.

properties.name: spring.mvc.format.time
properties.description: Time format to use, for example 'HH:mm:ss'. Used for formatting of java.time's LocalTime and OffsetTime.

properties.name: spring.mvc.formcontent.filter.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable Spring's FormContentFilter.

properties.name: spring.mvc.hiddenmethod.filter.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable Spring's HiddenHttpMethodFilter.

properties.name: spring.mvc.log-request-details
properties.description: Whether logging of (potentially sensitive) request details at DEBUG and TRACE level is allowed.

properties.name: spring.mvc.log-resolved-exception
properties.description: Whether to enable warn logging of exceptions resolved by a "HandlerExceptionResolver", except for "DefaultHandlerExceptionResolver".

properties.name: spring.mvc.message-codes-resolver-format
properties.description: Formatting strategy for message codes. For instance, 'PREFIX_ERROR_CODE'.

properties.name: spring.mvc.pathmatch.matching-strategy
properties.description: Choice of strategy for matching request paths against registered mappings.

properties.name: spring.mvc.problemdetails.enabled
properties.description: Whether RFC 9457 Problem Details support should be enabled.

properties.name: spring.mvc.publish-request-handled-events
properties.description: Whether to publish a ServletRequestHandledEvent at the end of each request.

properties.name: spring.mvc.servlet.load-on-startup
properties.description: Load on startup priority of the dispatcher servlet.

properties.name: spring.mvc.servlet.path
properties.description: Path of the dispatcher servlet. Setting a custom value for this property is not compatible with the PathPatternParser matching strategy.

properties.name: spring.mvc.static-path-pattern
properties.description: Path pattern used for static resources.

properties.name: spring.mvc.view.prefix
properties.description: Spring MVC view prefix.

properties.name: spring.mvc.view.suffix
properties.description: Spring MVC view suffix.

properties.name: spring.mvc.webjars-path-pattern
properties.description: Path pattern used for WebJar assets.

properties.name: spring.mvc.date-format
properties.description: Date format to use, for example 'dd/MM/yyyy'.

properties.name: spring.mvc.favicon.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable resolution of favicon.ico.

properties.name: spring.mvc.formcontent.putfilter.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable Spring's HttpPutFormContentFilter.
